description: This Java class 'TimerSchedulerMemento' manages the state of scheduled tasks, including tracking started task IDs and error task IDs within the OpenMRS scheduling system. It extends 'OpenmrsMemento' to support state persistence and includes methods for manipulating error task sets.

classes.name: TimerSchedulerMemento
classes.description: A class that stores and manages the state of timer scheduler tasks, including both started tasks and error tasks.

methods.name: TimerSchedulerMemento
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the memento with a set of started task IDs.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state representing started task IDs.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the internal started task IDs from an external state object.

methods.name: addErrorTask
methods.description: Adds a task ID to the set of error tasks.

methods.name: removeErrorTask
methods.description: Removes a task ID from the set of error tasks.

methods.name: getErrorTasks
methods.description: Returns the set of error task IDs.

methods.name: saveErrorTasks
methods.description: Merges error task IDs into the started task IDs set.
